# IEEE RAS / PaperCept LaTeX Reference

These files are an unmodified local reference copy of the LaTeX
materials distributed by IEEE RAS PaperCept.

Source:
https://ras.papercept.net/conferences/support/tex.php

Downloaded:
YYYY-MM-DD

## Contents

- `ieeeconf.cls`
  Official conference class distributed in `ieeeconf.zip`.

- `root.tex`
  Official sample manuscript source.

- `root.pdf`
  Compiled official sample, useful for visual comparison.

- `IEEEtran.bst`
  IEEE bibliography style.

- `IEEEtran_HOWTO.pdf`
  IEEE LaTeX usage guide.

## Rules

These files are vendor/reference material.

DO NOT:
- edit them;
- reformat them;
- use them as scratch files;
- apply manuscript revisions to them.

The active manuscript lives outside this directory.

When checking submission compliance, compare `paper/main.tex` and the
compiled paper against these files and the current conference website.

The conference-specific instructions take precedence over this cached
reference if they differ.
